notes.title: 1.0.052 Minor Update
notes.notes:
Optimize Backpack UI Type Switching: Keyboard : Q/E keys, Controller : shoulder buttons (L1/R1 or LB/RB) 
Resolve the issue where UI on PauseMenu fail to display properly at certain special resolutions.

notes.title: 1.0.05 Minor Update
notes.notes: Fix dash attack looping couldn't exit

notes.title: 1.0.05 Update| Multi-language support
notes.notes:
Added multi-language support. ( PS: Due to time and budget constraints, the translation quality may not be perfect. We hope for your understanding.）
 Lampwick Ring: Players who have defeated Red Boy can directly obtain it in the 6th stage. 
 Fine-tuned the perfect timing range for "Disrupt" (Counter Move). 
 Increased invincibility frames and the Burning Blade value for perfect counterattacks with the "Dagger" weapon type. 
 Optimized running cancel. 
 Optimized some levels return points.

notes.title: 1.0.04 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added Ring: Lamp Wick Ring, obtained by defeating Red Boy, providing a transition for mid-to-late game adventures for newly added characters.
 Adjusted Skill: Slash Stick, moved to the position of the Wolf Vanguard in Chapter 1; players who haven’t obtained it can challenge again to unlock.
 Adjusted Skill: Slash Stick, unlocks charging stages based on level.
 Reduced the skill multiplier for Boss Ren Shen Jing.
 Nerfed the grab detection for Boss Yu Long Wang.
 Adjusted some air walls.

notes.title: 1.0.03 Update Notes
notes.notes:
New skill: Stick Strike, unlocked after defeating Red Boy.
 New accessory: Bai Jing'er’s Fish Pendant, available from the first chapter.
 Added repeatable challenge for the Kōshi (廣志) boss.
 Added return teleport points in certain scenes.
 Increased base drop rate and base healing amount.
 Adjusted some invisible walls.
 Adjusted enemy and player attack detection.
 Fixed some level BGM and UI issues.

notes.title: 1.0.021 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Adjusted some invisible walls
 Tweaked hit detection for certain enemy and player moves
 Added return teleport points in some scenes

notes.title: 1.0.02 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where some weapon switching techniques could not be triggered
 Fixed a bug where the shop page would sometimes open with no purchase or sell options
 Reduced health and attack power of some bosses during the main progression
 Fixed an issue with volume settings not saving
 Fixed a bug where auto-save points in some areas could trigger a death
 Fixed lingering actor models in some areas
 Optimized some text expressions
